description: Fact-recovery tasks about the pi-cbmem implementation in this repository.

tasks.question: From the supplied evidence, report the bridge executable as a home-relative path and the CBM_LOG_LEVEL value.

Inspect pi-cbmem and identify both destructive operations that require confirmation and the two Pi modes where confirmation is allowed. Normalize the operation answers as tool or tool:mode and modes as a comma-separated list in source order.
Inspect pi-cbmem and report its maximum output lines, maximum output size label, and which complete JSON response is selected from noisy stdout. Return the JSON selection rule as last_complete_json.
Inspect pi-cbmem and report the first cancellation signal, fallback signal, and force-kill delay in milliseconds.
